messages.subject: CBX-417 licensing project - engagement & NDA
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Following our call, Hartwell would like to instruct Whitfield Carter on the proposed in-licensing of Calbryn Therapeutics' CBX-417 oncology portfolio. Could you send your engagement terms, and a mutual NDA we can put in front of Calbryn this week? We'd like to move quickly - their board meets at the end of the month.

Best,
Naomi Adeyemi
General Counsel, Hartwell Pharma Limited

messages.plaintextBody:
Naomi,

Delighted to act. Our engagement letter is on its way under separate cover. I've asked James Osei (senior associate) to lead day to day, with Tom Gallagher supporting. We've prepared a mutual confidentiality agreement on our standard terms - happy for you to send it straight to Calbryn once you've had a look.

We'll codename this Project Vertex internally.

Kind regards,

Sarah Whitfield
